title: claude-auto launcher config (claude-auto.json)
description: ~/.claude/claude-auto.json or the file CLAUDE_AUTO_CONFIG names. Every bad value falls back to that key's default with a warning at launch; nothing fails. Paths: ~/..., forward slashes, or doubled backslashes.

$schema.description: The schema an editor validates this file against; the launcher ignores it.

version.description: Config format version. Absent = 1. A file with a higher version than the launcher knows is read best-effort with one warning.

accounts.description: The account roster. An empty list, a key outside 1-8 characters, a duplicate key, a root that is not absolute, or not exactly one account with root ~/.claude discards the whole roster for the single default account.

root.description: The account's config directory, absolute; exactly one account has ~/.claude (the canonical one).

label.description: Shown on the tab strip; default '<key> account'.

tint.description: The account's colour (case-insensitive); anything else falls back to Green with a warning.

hidden.description: Left out of the tab strip and the no-UI prompt's text, still typeable there.

archived.description: Ignored entirely; refused on the canonical account.

sharing.description: Share one profile's files across accounts (hardlinks, junctions, the MCP mirror). Forced off with fewer than two accounts. Module 'sharing'.

remote.description: The Remote row and the companion launch (author setup). Module 'remote'.

riderMcp.description: Rider MCP endpoint scan: auto scans only while Rider runs. Module 'rider-mcp'.

extraMcpConfigs.description: MCP config files passed to claude with --mcp-config; each absolute, a relative one is skipped with a warning.

secretsRoot.description: Absolute path of the secrets folder.

vsecPath.description: Absolute path of vsec.exe or its shim (author setup); empty = CLAUDE_AUTO_VSEC, then PATH.

launchHooks.description: Scripts (.ps1, .js, .mjs, .cmd) run after the account choice in the chosen project, best-effort. Entries run at the same time; an entry that is a list of paths runs them in order. Absolute paths.

maintenanceActions.description: Extra keys on the maintenance screen. A key outside the rules or a missing or relative script skips the entry with a warning; a duplicate key keeps the first.

key.description: One character a-z or 0-9, outside u r d m p l c b.

label.description: Shown on the maintenance screen; default the key.

script.description: Absolute path of the script to run.

rows.description: The launch rows in drawing order; an unlisted row is hidden and launches with its hiddenValues entry, else its default. account is always shown, first when unlisted. Default: every row.

hiddenValues.description: Row name -> the value a hidden row launches with. Values: model default or a family key (haiku, sonnet1m, opus1m, fable); effort default, low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultracode; advisor default, fable, opus, off; permission default, plan, auto, acceptEdits, bypass; mode normal, safe; remote on, off.

modelOrder.description: Model families on the model row after default, in this order; an unlisted family is hidden.

hiddenProjects.description: Projects the project screen leaves out: absolute paths, case-insensitive; 'h' edits the list.

pinnedProjects.description: Projects the project screen lists first, in this order: absolute paths, case-insensitive; 'p' edits the list.

hideHeadlessProjects.description: Hide a project with no interactive session (only sdk-* transcripts), even a git root.

projectScreen.description: always: the project screen after every launch screen; onDemand: Enter launches in the launch directory and the action row picks what it does.

mouse.description: Mouse input (hover, click, wheel); CLAUDE_AUTO_NO_MOUSE=1 turns it off whatever this says. Module 'mouse'.

plugins.description: The only plugin processes that ever run (README, Plugins). A bad entry is skipped with a warning.

path.description: Absolute path of the plugin's executable, never looked up on PATH.

selfUpdate.description: The launcher's own update from its GitHub releases: notify shows a line, auto updates in the background, off never checks.

updateRepo.description: The GitHub owner/name whose releases the launcher updates from.
